about: The suite's lanes (Mission 21, Phase 0; scripts/test-lane.ts). On every push: each spec file under push.under ms by test/timings.json, every file in test/small/, any spec not yet timed, and the sentinels below. Nightly and on demand: everything, with the long descents and the browser specs. A sentinel is a whole-world or whole-adventure spec kept on every push for what only it proves, each with why; keep the list short (its time is the push lane's).

sentinels.test/gold-follow.test.ts: gold only after Follow, in a generated country's own errand and notices
sentinels.test/signal-inside.test.ts: every signal in a generated first town resolves to its act
sentinels.test/map-in-site.test.ts: the map from inside a site in wild country
sentinels.test/world-starts.test.ts: generated worlds start, across seeds and origins
sentinels.test/low-water-company.test.ts: an authored campaign's company and its first scenes (Low Water)
sentinels.test/the-grand-tour-second.test.ts: an integrated adventure's second leg (the Grand Tour)
sentinels.test/undertown-orders.test.ts: the undertown's orders (the first town's chain)
sentinels.test/winter-in-carth-wander.test.ts: an authored adventure wandered (A Winter in Carth)
